title: Prevent observation equity tokens from satisfying option freshness
business_goal: Exclude the sampled cash observation equity ticks from option-feed freshness attribution while preserving their ordinary LTP and shadow-observation routing.
current_behavior: The tick callback uses a general token-to-symbol map for option freshness; this map also contains cash observation equities, so those equity ticks can be attributed as option freshness.
expected_behavior: The callback updates option freshness only for non-underlying tokens classified to a production index option symbol; observation equities continue updating ordinary LTP and observation evidence.
in_scope: subscription mutation reconciliation and option freshness readers
out_of_scope: risk gates, kill switches, and freshness thresholds
acceptance_criteria: cash observation equity ticks update ordinary LTP and shadow-observation routing but do not update option freshness
a selected non-underlying token classified to a production index updates option freshness
underlying, sticky, unselected, and unknown tokens do not update option freshness in the callback path
observation equity tokens classified to their cash symbol do not update option freshness
option freshness statistics include only contracts in a KNOWN snapshot for the active socket generation
ownership snapshot remains UNKNOWN after queued, failed, partial, or stale-generation mutation
installed sidecar stages the exact post-prune and post-budget production CE/PE set while keeping cash observations separate
socket loss invalidates ownership and failed connect replay cannot report RUNNING or KNOWN
index-only subscription mutations do not invalidate option ownership
ownership changes clear option freshness for affected symbols
callback classification tests distinguish cash observation ticks from selected option tokens
the callback test path is classified as material and covered by this work item and claim
architecture_impact: Option freshness and health attribution use validated CE/PE instrument identities from the instrument master and an immutable applied-local-subscription snapshot. Candidate resolver maps remain proposals; only synchronous local API reconciliation can establish KNOWN ownership. Generation transitions and uncertain mutations fail closed. This does not prove broker/exchange delivery or overall feed readiness.
expected_tests: python3 -m py_compile core/kite_depth_ws.py core/depth_subscription_engine.py tests/test_kite_depth_ws_observation_on_ticks.py tests/test_kite_depth_ws_stability.py tests/test_depth_subscription_refresh_contract.py tests/test_depth_subscription_tokens.py tests/governance/test_evidence_contract.py
Parse all changed governance evidence JSON documents.

underlying, sticky, unselected, and unknown token ticks
completed production token-build ownership excludes observation tokens
post-prune launch-plan metadata preserves only selected production option and underlying identities
unknown and invalid LTP values do not refresh option freshness

uat_criteria: offline callback tests preserve LTP/shadow routing and keep observation equities out of option freshness
release_gates: required delivery lifecycle evidence for callback attribution and applied-ownership reconciliation
focused callback, mutation, and evidence-contract tests
rollback_plan: Revert this scoped ownership-map change and its tests; do not modify or restart any running process.

evidence_standard.applicability_reason: This work changes material feed attribution behavior and its focused regression coverage.

claims.statement: Cash observation equity tokens classified to their cash symbol do not update option freshness; selected non-underlying tokens classified to production index symbols retain option-freshness behavior.
claims.limitation: This claim covers local callback attribution and synchronous local websocket API application only. It does not prove remote exchange delivery, establish the global cause of feed health status, overall feed readiness, or any change to the running process.
